observations: Predicted 0.2 s for a 20 cm catch, then locked the answer.
One drop produced 16.4 cm = 0.18 s; five more produced six catches spanning 12.6–27.4 cm and 0.16–0.24 s.
The visual aligns ruler distance with a nonlinear time scale and catch marks. It explicitly says this is a simulated catcher, not a measurement of my reflex.
Reveal accurately cites the six observed catches and derives t = sqrt(2d/g), converting 20 cm to 0.20 s.
